name: Khurmi
instructions: 1. Dissolve jaggery in warm water to create a syrup and strain it to remove impurities.
2. In a bowl, mix wheat flour, sesame seeds, fennel seeds, and a few tablespoons of warm ghee.
3. Slowly add the jaggery syrup to the flour mixture to form a very stiff, tight dough.
4. Roll out the dough into a thick sheet and cut into desired shapes, typically diamonds or small squares.
5. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan and deep-fry the pieces on medium-low heat until they turn deep golden brown and crunchy.
6. Remove and let them cool completely; they will harden further as they set.
description: Khurmi is a traditional, rustic sweet snack from Chhattisgarh, often prepared during festivals or kept as a long-lasting dry snack in rural households. It is appreciated for its simple ingredients, satisfying crunch, and long shelf life.
